title: In vivo and in vitro evidence for growth hormone-like bioactivity of Rhizoma Anemarrhenae extract.
authors: Wang, Yao-Chien; Chen, Kuang Ting; Lin, Sheng-Chun; Hsu, Yu-An; Chang, Ching-Yao; Lin, En-Shyh; Lin, Hui-Ju; Chen, Chih-Sheng; Wan, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药提取物模拟生长激素生物活性，涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Certain herbs used in traditional Chinese medicine may produce a growth-enhancing effect by promoting the secretion of growth hormone (GH) by the pituitary gland or mimicking the function of GH. In this study, we aimed to identify herbs that could serve as GH alternatives. A reporter gene assay for GH was developed, and 100 different herbal extracts were assayed. We found that Rhizoma Anemarrhenae (RA) water extracts exhibited transactivation activities that stimulate the activation of signal transducer and activator of transcription 5 (STAT5). The growth-promoting effect of RA in NB2-11 cells was inhibited by co-treatment with GH receptor (GHR)-Fc fusion protein. Unlike GH, RA extracts did not enhance the growth of B16F10 melanoma cells. The activation of the Janus kinase 2-STAT5 signaling pathway was confirmed in both NB2-11 cells and WI-38 human normal lung fibroblasts; the activation was inhibited by co-treatment with GHR-Fc fusion protein. Docking analysis of the active ingredients of RA, including mangiferin, neomangiferin, isomangiferin, anemarsaponin E, 7-O-methylmangiferin, officinalisinin I, timosaponin BII, timosaponin AI, and timosaponin AIII, using SWISSDOCK indicated a direct interaction of these compounds with GHR. The growth-promoting effects and activation of STAT5 were also confirmed. Moreover, we found that RA extract significantly increased the height of the tibial growth plate and stimulated the production of insulin-like growth factor 1 in the serum, liver, and muscle tissues. Our findings provide evidence that herbal extracts, particularly, RA extracts, can promote growth by mimicking GH bioactivity.
abstract_zh: 中医中使用的某些草药可能通过促进垂体分泌生长激素（GH）或模拟GH功能而产生促生长作用。在本研究中，我们旨在鉴定可作为GH替代品的草药。开发了一种针对GH的报告基因检测方法，并对100种不同的草药提取物进行了检测。我们发现知母（Rhizoma Anemarrhenae, RA）水提取物表现出反式激活活性，可刺激信号转导与转录激活因子5（STAT5）的激活。在NB2-11细胞中，RA的促生长作用通过共处理GH受体（GHR）-Fc融合蛋白而被抑制。与GH不同，RA提取物未增强B16F10黑色素瘤细胞的生长。在NB2-11细胞和WI-38人正常肺成纤维细胞中，均确认了Janus激酶2-STAT5信号通路的激活；该激活通过共处理GHR-Fc融合蛋白而被抑制。使用SWISSDOCK对RA活性成分（包括芒果苷、新芒果苷、异芒果苷、知母皂苷E、7-O-甲基芒果苷、知母内酯I、知母皂苷BII、知母皂苷AI和知母皂苷AIII）进行对接分析，表明这些化合物与GHR直接相互作用。促生长效应和STAT5的激活也得到了确认。此外，我们发现RA提取物显著增加了胫骨生长板的高度，并刺激了血清、肝脏和肌肉组织中胰岛素样生长因子1的产生。我们的研究结果提供证据表明，草药提取物，特别是RA提取物，可通过模拟GH生物活性来促进生长。
